public static final class SleepTask.Builder extends com.google.protobuf.GeneratedMessage.Builder<SleepTask.Builder> implements SleepTaskOrBuilder
Finds, approaches, and enters a bed. A supplied position pins the task to
one bed; otherwise the nearest loaded bed is selected.
